anomalies.observed: In the 'Decoupling Capacitors' block on the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch, page 1), C3 is drawn with value '100u' (100 µF) between VCC and GND, while its neighbours C2, C4, C5, C6 are all drawn as '100n'.
anomalies.expected: The specification states C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 are each 100 nF local bypass capacitors on VCC–GND; C3 should therefore be 100 nF, not 100 µF.

evidence.quote: Decoupling Capacitors block, page 1: 'C3 100u' between VCC and GND (C2/C4/C5/C6 shown as '100n')
C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 — 100 nF each, VCC–GND (local bypass)

anomalies.impact: A 100 µF part in a 100 nF bypass position changes the bulk/inrush behaviour of the VCC rail and provides no high-frequency decoupling at that location; the board's power integrity differs from the intended design (and the footprint may not even accept a 100 µF part).

anomalies.observed: On the root sheet, the MCU reset pin (U2 pin 7, NRST, held up by R10 to VCC) carries the local label 'NRST', while J1 pin 3 carries the local label 'RESET'. The two differently named local labels on the same sheet do not join into one net.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires NRST to be wired to J1 pin 3 (~RESET) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull the MCU reset low.

evidence.quote: Page 1: MCU pin 7 label 'NRST'; J1 (Conn_ARM_SWD_TagConnect_TC2030) pin 3 label 'RESET'
Reset line: R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC... NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~RESET) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.

anomalies.impact: The programmer's reset output is left on a dangling net; external reset assertion via the SWD connector is lost, so the MCU cannot be reset through J1.

parsed.summary: The design is largely faithful to the specification (NFC/display/TSC wiring, pull-ups, SSD1306 I2C strapping and charge-pump parts all match), but C3 is drawn as 100 µF instead of the specified 100 nF bypass value, and the J1 reset pin label 'RESET' does not match the MCU's 'NRST' net, leaving the programmer reset line disconnected.
